Ready for the maintainer to merge at the next minor cut.

This is a safety-tier review. The change alters generated toolpaths.

The angle reaches the Parallel raster in the active work coordinates. Other patterns keep their existing paths and stamps. The command validates the angle before generation. The project reader supplies zero for an absent field. The UI uses the existing undoable parameter command. Both before/after screenshots are present and accessible.

## Local results

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3426`. No GitHub runner was used.

The tested trial merge is `a5de38b923c7b4eead6812937ff6f71c9f698235`. Its first parent is the PR head. Its second parent is upstream/main `69997a6ded2d6ca559601c9233629045caabecda`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 213 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. Tests: 3,864 passed, 85 ignored. |
| App direction suite | 4 passed. Covers flat-top tracks, sloped contact, clipping, WCS yaw, verification, invalid input, and other patterns. |
| App MCP suite | 26 passed. Includes angle edit, undo/redo, project round-trip, and the old zero-angle cache. |
| App CL goldens | 33 passed. |
| UI library | 1,477 passed, 8 ignored. Includes the Direction angle Apply/undo test. |
| Strict Clippy | Passed for all app, motion, and UI targets with `-D warnings`. |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 3 steps passed. Both light twins passed. |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | 251 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. Tests: 110 passed. Four registered known failures failed at their expected assertions. |

heavy lanes green on 832434c59589947a25b903df4860c5acec5a8e2e

Heavy base: `69997a6ded2d6ca559601c9233629045caabecda`. All reached app and motion heavy targets ran. The results include 33 finishing tests and all six shared-face no-gouge bands.

## Extra suites run

- `app suites: example_catalog`: 37 passed, 4 ignored.
- `app suites: example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `app suites: example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `app suites: golden_cl`: 33 passed.

These suites ran by name in the quick gate. The diff changes no fixture directory or import code. No additional importer suite applies.

## Mutations

I compiled disposable copies of the motion source through a compiler wrapper. The checkout source stayed unchanged.

1. Replace the 90-degree vector with the zero-degree vector. The flat-top test failed at `crates/app/tests/finish3d_direction.rs:168` because the segment left its expected raster direction.
2. Reverse the oblique angle with `(cos, -sin)`. The sloped-face test failed at the same assertion for 45 degrees.

After restoration, all four direction tests passed. These expected mutation failures are separate from the green gate results.

## Goldens moved

None. No recorded `.nc`, `.cl`, catalog program, or snapshot PNG changed in this PR. I checked the complete file list and the golden-test diff.

## Requested before merge

None.

Nonblocking note: several existing operation and project source files exceed 400 lines and grow slightly in this diff. Keep future additions at their domain seams.

Main advanced during the run. Its later changes concern posts, sheet nesting, and the 2D pre-drilled UI. The tested base and trial merge above identify the exact validation tree. The governing laws did not change.

No physical machine run was performed. The worktree and branch remain in place to preserve the build cache.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Second safety read of head `832434c59` (read-only Opus agent, nothing built). This comment is not the review. The review of mkinney on this head stands.

**Result: no blocker.**

- **Direction.** `raster_pass_spaced` already works for each direction (Scallop uses the diagonals). Each sample goes to the same drop-cutter projection in the same XY frame. Links, bridges, rim rows and the first plunge do not read the direction.
- **Default.** Angle 0 gives the old Parallel tuple exactly. `golden_cl.rs` asserts that the moves at angle 0 equal `parallel()`. No `.cl`, `.nc`, catalog program or PNG is in the diff.
- **Bad angles.** Each value outside [0, 360) is refused when the command is created, and again in the generator. This includes NaN, infinite, negative and 360.
- **Command and undo.** The UI field goes through `EditOperationParams`. MCP uses the same parameter. Tests pin add, edit, undo, redo, an old file and the refused values.
- **Merge.** `git merge-tree` with main is clean.

**Maintainer decision (owner's standing word 2026-11-22: choose recommended while he sleeps) - project version step.**
The new key `direction_angle` takes no `PROJECT_VERSION` step. An older build drops the key and cuts along +X.
- Option 1 (taken, recommended): no step. The path of the older build is a valid drop-cutter path on the same model, in a different direction. The same was accepted for `pass_start` (#3316), `gap_link` and `fill_openings`. A step is necessary where an older reader posts something wrong or unsafe (#3447, #1890).
- Option 2 (dropped): a step to 78. It makes each older build refuse each file that has an angle, for no safety gain.

The trial merge on the current main (`edcbfe4dd`) is in the queue. The merge follows a green trial.

Trial merge result (merge `774a38421`, not pushed; parents: main `5ce2abe61` and head `832434c59`). All steps are green.

- `camcraft-motion`: lib 548 passed; `finish3d` 55, `finish3d_gaplink` 7, `finish3d_holes` 5, `finish3d_land` 7, `finish3d_overhang_and_chord` 3, `scallop_ceiling` 4, `multiaxis` 7; 0 failed. The other motion binaries up to `level_links` also passed (997 passed in total). `machining2d` and the binaries after it did not run.
- `camcraft-app`: lib 298 passed; `finish3d_direction` 4, `mcp` 26, `golden_cl` 33, `operations` 121, `area_controls` 13, `project_roundtrip` 80, `setup_align_3d` 6, `wcs_start` 6, `import_step_q02_mold` 1, `verify` 21, `shared_face_bodies_finish` 2, `conformance` 7, the three `example_catalog` suites, `first_part_programs` 2; 0 failed.
- `camcraft-ui` lib: 1482 passed, 0 failed.
- clippy with `-D warnings` on `camcraft-motion --all-targets`, `camcraft-app --lib`, `camcraft-ui --all-targets`: clean.

No heavy lane ran (`P6`; the heavy lanes run at the cut).

The merge waits for one thing: main is red (#3602, a test that #3485 made stale). The fix is in work. This PR merges after that fix.

Merge note. Class: no refresh (head `832434c59` merged unchanged as `1b332695a`). Basis: the review of mkinney on this head, the second safety read (no blocker), the recorded decision on the project version step, and the trial merge on main `5ce2abe61` (all steps that ran are green). Main moved after the trial by #3228 (post), #3603 (one test file), #3595 (verifier) and #3599 (verifier finding); `git merge-tree` with main `e8fc84062` is clean. The post-merge run of the merge commit is the check of the tip.
